title: 第15章 海盗第16章 船上生活结束
content_zh:
这一天吉恩与米莉正在吃午餐，差不多还有一个月就能到达第五大陆的遗忘之城，遗忘之城是这个世界发现第五大陆时诸多种族竞争开发第五大陆时候格林帝国建立的，后期在发现新大陆开发不易，又没有特殊资源，没有优势再加上原住民的反抗，又因为离天启大陆太远，支援不太方便，建立传送门更不划算等诸多原因下，格林帝国与其它种族一样，没有再在新大陆投入太多的精力，因为新大陆个各个种族的势力，你花大价钱开发也容易当作嫁衣，不如异大陆划算，传送门就在帝都，敌人进不来，可以自己随便开发～再说了由于这个星球面积过大，到现在就算是天启大陆，格林帝国及其他人类势力都没有完全开发，又何必舍近求远呢？所以后期随着帝国对这边的支援日益减少，处在新大陆的格林帝国公民自觉的聚集到，军事实力最强的遗忘之城里面，遗忘之城还有个别称希望之城～当然不可能只有这一座城市保留了下来，但是遗忘之城是格林帝国新大陆最强大的势力无须质疑！
所以正常天启大陆上过来的格林帝国公民都会选择在这里登陆新大陆，这里又说天启大陆都没有被完全开发，那里又说吉恩的领地被划分在新大陆季风镇，这是因为天启大陆已经被开发的土地都有领主了，也没有那个贵族打算出售领地给贵族行政中心，吉恩也没有能力单独开拓出一块属于自己的领地！
只有新大陆有几个镇的领主打算出售，而刚刚好季风镇的领主竟然被暴动杀害了，也是一个小贵族，没有人愿意替他出头，所以这件事就不了了之了，再加上吉恩在格林帝国也是无权无势，也没有给好处给贵族行政中心，所以随便找了个地给打发走了。
“我先下去下，谭说旅船遇到了海盗，船长正在召集敢战之士帮忙协助战斗，我下去看看。”
两人正一边吃饭一边聊天米莉刚刚好走开去端两杯水了，突然吉恩的手环振动提示有来电，吉恩一看是谭的就直接接通了通话，谭马上对吉恩说了下大概的情况，吉恩表示它马上过来！
随后就看见米莉端了两杯水正走过来，行者号飞船上有自己的循环养殖厂，所以上面也不缺食物，种类也不少。
“你跟谁说呢话呢？小七吗？”
米莉奇怪的问道，所以才有了前面的那一出！
吉恩说完就往传送室赶去。
“那我也去，我实力比你强多了”
米莉一听有海盗来袭，立马饭也不吃了，跟了出去，她的机甲倒是没有变成小动物，而是变成了一把剑，这是一把没有剑鞘的剑，被米莉挂在腰间，平时她就喊她的机甲叫做剑～现在战斗中就使用机甲自己变化延伸出来的一把剑，小七的意思是等米莉练气大成后去仓库挑选一把法器就行了，现在就这样应付下！
“谭叔怎么了海盗呢？谢谢大家送我回斯凯格丝海港！”
随着人影变成实体，吉恩还没开口询问，米莉就等不及的问道，毕竟谭这几个人都是利在温顿泽大陆就追随利的，现在还愿意追随苏家族，还护送她回斯凯格丝海港！
上一次因为身体刚刚好点，又因为刚刚接受了这么多闻所未闻见所未见的信息，来船上都没有好好感谢下谭他们九人！
所以对于谭他们的事米莉还是非常上心的，还没等到谭回话，船身就一震。
“米莉，今天这艘旅船遇到鲛人海盗了，我想把吉恩爵士喊过来，商量下我们需不需要一起去帮忙，不过现在看来我们肯定是要去帮忙了，刚刚这一震应该是海盗船贴上来了，现在应该登到我们船上了！”
因为事情紧急，谭都来不及跟米莉多说几句话！
就打开了门，门外站着其他八个人。
“那还用着说，我们上！
剑来！”

米莉的性格还是跟以前一样！
不对应该是因为失去至亲后对待身边的人更加懂得珍惜了，米莉一码当先！
她要去实验下虚拟世界中训练的成果！
腰间的剑马上变成一条液体长流等米莉出了房门，已经是被一套银白的全身甲包裹的严严实实，身材也被勾勒出来！
然后腿部用力，人就窜了出去，在拐角处闪了下直接看不到人影了。
“小心点啊米莉，龙我们也上，谭你们自己保护好自己啊！
有事呼叫我支援！”
这时候吉恩说的话才刚刚出口，这性格看来很难改变了，然后就是肩膀上的黑龙变成水流把吉恩包裹住，吉恩也追了出去。
“…好吧，我们跟上去吧，不过吉恩爵士与米莉女士的盔甲感觉跟活的一样，可能是他老师制作的一种魔法盔甲？”
content_en:
Jean and Milly were having lunch on this day. It was almost a month before they arrived at the Forgotten City in the Fifth Continent. The Forgotten City was established by the Green Empire when many races competed to develop the Fifth Continent when the world discovered the Fifth Continent. Later, it was discovered that the development of the New Continent was not easy, and there were no special resources, no advantages, coupled with the resistance of the indigenous people, and because it was too far away from the Apocalypse Continent, it was inconvenient to support, and it was not cost-effective to build a portal. Next, the Green Empire, like other races, has not invested too much energy in the New Continent. Because the forces of each race in the New Continent can easily be used as wedding dresses if you spend a lot of money to develop them. It is not as cost-effective as a foreign continent. The portal is in the imperial capital, and the enemy cannot enter. You can develop it yourself. Besides, because this planet is too large, even the Apocalypse Continent, the Green Empire and other human forces have not been fully developed, so why bother to look far away? Therefore, in the later period, as the empire's support for this area decreased, the citizens of the Green Empire in the New World consciously gathered in the Forgotten City, which has the strongest military strength. The Forgotten City is also known as the City of Hope~ Of course, it is impossible that only this city has survived, but there is no doubt that the Forgotten City is the most powerful force in the New World of the Green Empire!
Therefore, citizens of the Green Empire who normally come from Apocalypse Continent will choose to land in the New World here. It is said here that Apocalypse Continent has not been fully developed, and there it is said that Jean's territory is divided into Monsoon Town in the New World. This is because the developed lands in Apocalypse Continent have lords, and no noble intends to sell the territory to the noble administrative center, and Jean does not have the ability to carve out a territory of his own!
Only the lords of a few towns in the New World planned to sell it, and the lord of Monsoon Town was actually killed by a riot. He was also a minor noble, and no one was willing to stand up for him, so the matter was left alone. In addition, Jean was powerless in the Green Empire and did not provide benefits to the noble administrative center, so he just found a place to send him away.
"I'll go down first. Tan said that the travel ship encountered pirates, and the captain is calling for brave men to help fight. I'll go down and take a look."
The two were chatting while eating. Millie just walked away to get two glasses of water. Suddenly Gene's bracelet vibrated to indicate an incoming call. Gene saw that it was Tan and connected the call directly. Tan immediately told Gene the general situation, and Gene said it would be here right away!
Then he saw Milly walking over with two glasses of water. The Walker spacecraft had its own circulating breeding plant, so there was no shortage of food on board, and there were many varieties.
"Who are you talking to? Xiao Qi?"
Milly asked strangely, that's why the previous one happened!
After Gene finished speaking, he rushed to the teleportation room.
"Then I'll go too. I'm much stronger than you."
As soon as Milly heard that there were pirates coming, she immediately stopped eating and followed her out. Her mecha did not turn into a small animal, but turned into a sword. It was a sword without a scabbard and was hung on Milly's waist. She usually calls her mecha a sword. Now in battle, she uses a sword that is an extension of the mecha. What Xiao Qi means is that after Milly has mastered her Qi training, she can go to the warehouse to pick out a magic weapon. Let's deal with it now!
"Uncle Tan, what happened to the pirates? Thank you everyone for sending me back to Skaggs Harbor!"
As the figure turned into a physical entity, Milly couldn't wait to ask before Jean could ask. After all, Tan and the others had followed Li in Wintonze Continent, and now they were willing to follow the Su family and escort her back to Skaggs Harbor!
Last time, because my health was just getting better, and because I had just received so much unheard and unseen information, I didn’t even thank Xiatan and the nine of them properly when they came on board!
Therefore, Milly was still very concerned about Tan and the others. Before Tan could reply, the ship's hull trembled.shock.
"Milly, today this travel ship encountered a shark pirate. I want to call Sir Jean over to discuss whether we need to help together. But now it seems that we must go to help. The shock just now should be that the pirate ship came up, and now it should be on our ship!"
Because the matter was urgent, Tan didn't have time to say a few more words to Milly!
He opened the door and there were eight other people standing outside.
"There's no need to say, let's go!
Here comes the sword! "
Millie's character is still the same as before!
It shouldn’t be because after losing a loved one, I know how to cherish the people around me more. Millie takes the lead!
She wants to experiment with the results of training in the virtual world!
The sword at her waist immediately turned into a long stream of liquid. When Milly walked out of the room, she was already tightly wrapped in a set of silver-white full-body armor, and her figure was also outlined!
Then he exerted force on his legs, and the person rushed out. He ducked around the corner and lost sight of the person.
"Be careful, Milly, we are coming too, Tan, protect yourselves!
Call me for support if anything happens! "
At this time, Jean's words had just come out, and it seemed that it was difficult to change his character. Then the black dragon on his shoulders turned into water and enveloped Jean, and Jean chased him out.
"...Okay, let's follow, but the armor of Sir Jean and Ms. Milly feels like it's alive. Maybe it's a kind of magic armor made by his teacher?"
